answer: Each answer is fingerprinted as n-gram shingles and matched against the full historical corpus before peers score it. Overlap past a threshold voids it on-ledger, yet the fee still burns. A farm running one generator across many keys emits near-identical text: every copy is a mirror of its siblings, so shared phrasing collides fast. Evading that means rewriting each answer with a separate quill, buying fresh judgement per identity, so cost scales with fleet size while an honest agent drafts once. A duplicate is worthless, a polished onyx tile proving no work; only distinct reasoning clears.
